mission: Govern the bounded transition from one exactly authorized external-action intent to one controlled execution attempt and immutable execution evidence, without determining whether an external effect occurred, whether an intended outcome occurred, whether ambiguity is reconciled, or whether the consequential-action lifecycle is closed.

fixed_certification_boundary.category_1: A declared Layer 18 invariant fails in a valid abstract history and can permit unauthorized execution, authority laundering, duplicate effect, unsafe retry, invalid execution identity, Human Principal bypass, executor self-certification or invalid authoritative handoff without first requiring failure of a legitimately deferred implementation mechanism.
fixed_certification_boundary.category_2: A physical implementation or runtime obligation explicitly allocated to a future owner with rationale, prerequisite, required evidence, fail-closed absence behavior and future certification condition.
fixed_certification_boundary.category_3: Optional hardening beyond the finite Material architectural correctness boundary.
fixed_certification_boundary.category_4: Documentation or non-material reconciliation incapable of changing authoritative execution behavior.

semantic_separation.AUTHORIZATION: Predecessor-owned Human or expressly delegated authority for one exact action; Layer 18 only validates and consumes it.
semantic_separation.ENFORCEMENT: Layer 14-owned protected-action runtime decision, uniqueness, permit, mediation, pre-effect revalidation and effect barrier semantics.
semantic_separation.EXECUTION: Layer 18-owned bounded attempt registration, dispatch governance and executor-side evidence production after every exact predecessor guard passes.
semantic_separation.OBSERVATION: Evidence about external-system state produced by separately governed sources; executor observations are claims only.
semantic_separation.EFFECT: Whether the external system actually changed; never authoritatively determined by Layer 18.
semantic_separation.OUTCOME: Whether the intended consequential result occurred; never authoritatively determined by Layer 18.
semantic_separation.RECONCILIATION: Independent resolution of no-effect, exact-effect, duplicate, partial, conflicting or unknown external state outside Layer 18.
semantic_separation.CLOSURE: Final consequential-action lifecycle disposition outside Layer 18; Layer 18 audit is descendant evidence only.

does_not_own: business, Human, release, deployment, access, risk-acceptance, exception, waiver, recovery or compensation authorization

derivation_rules.object_schema: Project every object field, authority, cardinality, rank and prohibition without semantic addition or omission.
derivation_rules.transition_schema: Project every transition exactly from transition_rules.
derivation_rules.dag_node: Create one node for every object_type.
derivation_rules.dag_edge: Create one directed edge for each transition source type to its destination type.
derivation_rules.rank: Every edge must satisfy destination rank greater than source rank.
derivation_rules.documentation: May explain this model but may not add authority, mandatory predecessors, states, transitions, invariants or closure criteria.
derivation_rules.reconciliation: Compare projected identifiers, objects, state families and edge tuples for exact equality with this normative model.

invariants.text: Every Layer 18 binding consumes exactly one current predecessor-owned authorization identity/version/hash for exactly one ExternalActionId; Layer 18 cannot originate or reinterpret authority.
ExternalActionId, CanonicalBusinessActionId, AuthorityDomainId and EffectSlotId remain stable across every attempt, retry, recovery, evidence and handoff generation.
Every eligible attempt binds exactly one canonical current target identity/generation, action, complete typed parameter manifest and payload hash equal to the authorization.
Missing, ambiguous, stale, expired, revoked, superseded, mismatched or condition-failing authorization is ineligible and cannot dispatch.

Revocation and source-authoritative invalidation dominate eligibility, cached state, queues, permits, barriers, retries and dispatch; after dispatch they force containment, hold and handoff without implying no effect.
Layer 18 cannot widen scope, target, recipient, parameter, amount, currency, purpose, jurisdiction, confidentiality, time window, recurrence, executor or any constraint.
The observed executor and adapter identities must equal the exact authorized assignment and current Layer 13 identity/permission/attestation intersection.
Every ExecutionAttemptId and DispatchId is unique, immutable and bound to one action/domain/effect slot; duplicate registration or dispatch denies.

A retry preserves the same action/domain/effect slot and requires a future independent authoritative reconciliation disposition plus every separately required current authorization; executor evidence or handoff alone never permits retry.
At most one dispatch may consume one current Layer 14 effect barrier for one EffectSlotId; Layer 18 cannot create, reopen, replace or reuse the barrier.
Crash or recovery cannot erase dispatch possibility, consumed authority or evidence; any crash after possible dispatch enters unresolved-effect hold and cannot cause a second effect.

Timeout, silence, missing receipt, adapter acknowledgement or local failure after dispatch never proves no effect, successful effect or outcome and always blocks effect-bearing retry pending independent reconciliation.
Partial or contradictory execution evidence is preserved without aggregation or overwrite and produces unresolved-effect hold, independent handoff and required escalation.

Every registered attempt has an explicit append-only execution-evidence generation; missing is not empty and evidence cannot be rewritten, backfilled as contemporaneous or used to manufacture completion.
Every object preserves exact source authority, identity, version/hash, producer, time, boundary, predecessor/successor and limitation lineage sufficient for deterministic reconstruction.
Every unknown Material authorization, identity, target, parameter, constraint, revocation, barrier, attempt, prior-effect or evidence state fails closed.

Repository-defined Human Principal, exact-action, consequence-class, capital, legal/regulatory, public-statement, privacy/security, irreversible and compensation controls remain non-proxyable and cannot be weakened, cached, generalized or inferred.

The executor, adapter, dispatch record, receipt, telemetry and Layer 18 audit cannot authoritatively determine external effect, external-state truth, intended outcome, reconciliation or lifecycle closure.
Every attempt ends in a complete non-authoritative handoff to a separately governed reconciliation authority; dispatched attempts retain an unresolved-effect hold until that external authority acts.
Every predecessor retains its certified authority; Layer 18 objects cannot validate, modify, supersede, broaden or repair predecessor objects.
Compensation or remediation is a new consequential action requiring its own exact authorization, action identity, Layer 14 barrier and Layer 18 attempt; failure never creates compensation authority.

Execution eligibility, technical capability, possession of credentials, workflow readiness, release, assurance, admission, recommendation, decision, handoff, prior success or urgency cannot substitute for exact external-action authorization.

Every transition moves strictly forward in rank except a new retry generation enters through a future external disposition and new attempt identity; audit and evidence are never authority predecessors for effect-bearing action.
No production mechanism is treated as implemented, effective or empirically certified because its architecture contract exists.
Effect/Outcome Reconciliation and Closure remains institutionally separate, independently governed, unnumbered and outside Layer 18; sequencing creates no authority precedence.
